name: denver_flight
why: A trip with no flight is legwork: the real flights catalog is published and the search is called this turn (their search is free when they asked), real options come back with one question, [wait]. Never “let me know when you want me to look.” Spend discipline on a metered API: offers_search at most twice (“next Friday” can mean two dates), no dates_search when the date is fixed, no booking_options_get before the human picks. What the tool returned goes in the reply — carriers, times, prices.
inbound: I need to be in Denver next Friday for a client thing.

memory.subject: aim/business
memory.content: land two new clients this quarter
